name: Namaste Astu Bhagavan
text:
नमस्ते अस्तु भगवन् विश्वेश्वराय महादेवाय
त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिपुरान्तकाय त्रिकाग्निकालाय
कालाग्निरुद्राय नीलकण्ठाय मृत्युञ्जयाय
सर्वेश्वराय सदाशिवाय श्रीमन्महादेवाय नमः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva: lord of the universe, the great god, the three-eyed one, who ended the three cities, who is the fire of time, the blue-throated one, the conqueror of death, lord of all, the eternal and compassionate one.
purpose: A litany of Shiva’s names, recited as praise and as a gathering of attention.
supports: Steadying the mind through a rhythm of names; reverence; facing fear of endings.
when: After the opening prayer, or as the main recitation of a Monday practice.
note: Recited with the Sri Rudram. The client list prints it as one line; it is set out here in four for breath.
